questions.q: What nearly tossed Jim off the bowsprit into the sea?
choices: The flying jib filling with a report like a gun
A pirate rushing up the deck and pushing him off
A huge green wave breaking right over the bow
The anchor chain snapping and whipping past him
questions.evidence: the flying jib flapped and filled upon the other tack, with a report like a gun

questions.q: What did Jim find when the main-boom swung and showed him the after-deck?
choices: The two watchmen, one dead and one badly hurt
Long John Silver standing at the tiller steering
The whole pirate crew asleep on the bare planks
Captain Smollett tied up hand and foot to the mast
questions.evidence: There were the two watchmen, sure enough

questions.q: Seeing the blood on the planks, what did Jim decide had happened?
choices: The two men had killed each other in a drunken fight
The doctor had rowed out in the night and shot them
They had both fallen from the rigging while drunk
Ben Gunn had climbed aboard and attacked them both
questions.evidence: they had killed each other in their drunken wrath

questions.q: Why did Jim stop feeling pity for the moaning Israel Hands?
choices: He remembered what he had heard from the apple barrel
Hands snarled and threatened to cut his throat
Hands laughed at him and called him a little fool
He saw that Hands was gripping a loaded pistol
questions.evidence: when I remembered the talk I had overheard from the apple barrel, all pity left me

questions.q: Jim says "Come aboard, Mr. Hands" ironically. What does ironically mean here?
choices: Saying something mocking that is the opposite of what is true
Speaking in a very loud voice so people far away can hear
Speaking in a small, frightened whisper so no one notices
Giving a stiff, formal order the way a ship's officer does

questions.q: What was the one word Hands was able to say to Jim at first?
choices: Brandy
Water
Mercy
Silver
questions.evidence: All he could do was to utter one word

questions.q: Why had all the locked places in the cabin been broken open?
choices: The pirates were searching for the chart
The pirates were hunting for more food
The doctor had hidden his medicines there
The storm had thrown things and smashed them
questions.evidence: All the lockfast places had been broken open in quest of the chart

questions.q: What did the empty cellar and bottles tell Jim about the pirates?
choices: They had been drunk ever since the mutiny began
They had carefully saved their rum to drink later
They had rolled the full barrels ashore to the camp
They had eaten nothing but biscuit for many days
questions.evidence: not a man of them could ever have been sober

questions.q: What did Jim do just before he gave Hands the brandy?
choices: Had a good deep drink of water
Tied a bandage over Hands's leg
Pulled down the pirates' black flag
Turned the ship's head toward shore
questions.evidence: and then, and not till then, gave Hands the brandy

questions.q: Why did Jim put his own food behind the rudder head?
choices: To keep it out of the coxswain's reach
To keep it dry from the spray over the bow
To hide it from the sea birds on the rail
To save some of it for the doctor later on
questions.evidence: well out of the coxswain's reach

questions.q: What did Jim do with the pirates' black flag?
choices: Took it down and threw it overboard
Folded it and hid it in the sea-chest
Handed it to Israel Hands as a pillow
Tore it into strips to make a bandage
questions.evidence: handed down their cursed black flag, and chucked it overboard

questions.q: What deal did Hands offer Jim?
choices: Food, drink and a bandage, if Hands taught Jim to sail
Half of Flint's treasure, if Jim would set him free
A loaded pistol in return for a bottle of the brandy
A copy of the map, in exchange for the little coracle
questions.evidence: I'll tell you how to sail her

questions.q: Where did Jim say he meant to take the ship?
choices: Into North Inlet, to beach her quietly
Back to Captain Kidd's old anchorage
Out to sea and all the way home to Bristol
Up to the beach right below the stockade
questions.evidence: I mean to get into North Inlet and beach her quietly there

questions.q: What did Jim use to help Hands bind up his wound?
choices: A soft silk handkerchief of his mother's
A strip torn off the pirates' black flag
A piece of old sail cut from the main-sail
The sleeve torn off his own linen shirt
questions.evidence: a soft silk handkerchief of my mother's

questions.q: What does the coxswain's smile at the end of the chapter suggest?
choices: Hands is secretly planning to betray Jim
Hands is grateful and wants to be Jim's friend
Hands is weak and about to die from his wound
Hands is proud of how well Jim sails the ship
